target: 150-200 translation pairs, stratified, direction-balanced, excluded from round-5 training and from arm-B re-translation
selection_rule: Eligible pool = generation-record pairing verified (key match for real/llm; inline for seed-dup/twin) AND translation side present in the sealed r4 corpus under the expected source class AND zero overlap with the burned V43-TDUP surface. Quota: floor 20/stratum (pool-capped), remainder proportional to stratum pool (largest remainder), total 180; direction split half/half per stratum (extra seat ru->en when odd, cell-pool capped, shortfall top-up from any stratum, final trim drops pair_key-max from the over-represented direction). Within each (stratum, direction) cell: candidates sorted by pair_key, random.Random(42).sample over the sorted cell.
excluded_strata_note: translated-sibling excluded: record/sibling sides are not-duplicate contrast pairs, not translation pairs (batch justifications); twin-* treated as one stratum with deterministic direction parity assignment
